title: SMS messaging
adminsOnly: This area is restricted to NetGecko administrators.
settingsDescription: Saved to Airtable — applies to both the daily automatic run and manual sends.
disabledInfo: Sending is disabled — the daily job and manual sends do nothing. You can still preview the queue below.
liveWarning: LIVE mode — messages go to farmers' real phone numbers via Africa's Talking.
testInfoPhone: TEST mode — all messages are sent to {{phone}} with a [TEST] prefix; farmers receive nothing and loans are not marked as sent.
testInfoNoPhone: TEST mode with no test phone set — messages are simulated only, nothing is sent.
jobDescription: Runs automatically every day at 7:00 AM (EAT) when enabled. Rules already sent for a loan are skipped.
disabledRun: Nothing was sent — the feature is disabled. Enable it in Settings above first.
sentTestSummary: {{sent}} test SMS sent to the test number, {{errors}} failed.
scheduleDescription: What the rules would send today and over the next days, evaluated against live loans. Nothing here has been sent.
rulesDescription: Loaded live from the Airtable “SMS” table. Edit the rules there — this list refreshes on every page load.
logDescription: Messages recorded on loans (SMS date fields). Newest first.
noSendsYet: No SMS messages have been sent yet.
confirmContent: This sends today's due messages to farmers' phones via Africa's Talking and marks them on the loans. This cannot be undone.
confirmTest: TEST mode: today's due messages will be sent to {{phone}} only, with a [TEST] prefix. Farmers receive nothing and loans are not marked.
confirmDisabled: The feature is currently disabled — nothing will be sent. Enable it in Settings first to actually deliver messages.
runError: The SMS job failed. Try again or check the server logs.
